name: tcview
description: TcView: view and edit TwinCAT XML files as IEC Structured Text (ST).

twincat.performanceLogging.description: Enable performance timing logs for TcView open/scan operations.

twincat.backend.enabled.description: Enable the TcView C# backend process for TwinCAT project/library scanning.

twincat.backend.executablePath.description: Absolute path to TcView.Backend executable. Leave empty for auto-discovery (recommended).

twincat.backend.preferAutomationInterfac.description: Try TwinCAT Automation Interface first. When false, TcView uses TMC/source-first and uses Automation Interface as fallback.

twincat.backend.librarySourceRoots.description: Additional root folders to search for TwinCAT library source projects so TcView can resolve concrete library symbols.

twincat.backend.tmcRoots.description: Root folders to search for TwinCAT .tmc files used as compiled symbol/type context (ai > tmc > source > metadata).

twincat.backend.autoBuildTmcIfMissing.description: If no .tmc is found in the project path, TcView backend will attempt a best-effort TwinCAT Automation Interface build to generate one.

twincat.diagnostics.profile.description: Preset severity profile for diagnostics. balanced uses per-rule settings; strict and relaxed override them.

twincat.keywordCasing.description: Keyword casing used by the IEC ST formatter.

twincat.renameIncludeCommentsStrings.description: If true, rename/references include matches inside comments and string literals.

twincat.createMissingVariableDefaultSect.description: Default declaration section used by quick-fix: Declare missing variable.

twincat.diagnostics.typeMismatch.description: Severity for simple assignment type mismatch diagnostics.

explorer/context.when: resourceExtname == .TcPOU || resourceExtname == .TcGVL || resourceExtname == .TcDUT || resourceExtname == .TcPRG || resourceExtname == .TcAPP || resourceExtname == .TcCOM || resourceExtname == .TcVAR || resourceExtname == .TcGDS || resourceExtname == .TcIO || resourceExtname == .TcITF || resourceExtname == .tcpou || resourceExtname == .tcgvl || resourceExtname == .tcdut || resourceExtname == .tcprg || resourceExtname == .tcapp || resourceExtname == .tccom || resourceExtname == .tcvar || resourceExtname == .tcgds || resourceExtname == .tcio || resourceExtname == .tcitf

editor/title.when: resourceScheme == twincat || (resourceScheme == file && (resourceExtname == .TcPOU || resourceExtname == .TcGVL || resourceExtname == .TcDUT || resourceExtname == .TcPRG || resourceExtname == .TcAPP || resourceExtname == .TcCOM || resourceExtname == .TcVAR || resourceExtname == .TcGDS || resourceExtname == .TcIO || resourceExtname == .TcITF || resourceExtname == .tcpou || resourceExtname == .tcgvl || resourceExtname == .tcdut || resourceExtname == .tcprg || resourceExtname == .tcapp || resourceExtname == .tccom || resourceExtname == .tcvar || resourceExtname == .tcgds || resourceExtname == .tcio || resourceExtname == .tcitf))
